4.7.1 Cognito Integration 
 
Figure 27 Login Front-end Sequence Diagram  
Figure 27 delineates the sign in flow for a user; this sequence of events can be 
divided into two stages. First Cognito is called to validate the current user 
session, if this session has expired, which is at the time of writing set to one 
year, then the user will see the sign-in activity, otherwise they will be signed in.
